name: com.hainanqingxuan/china-eu-trade-mcp
title: QIXUA China-EU Trade, Supplier Risk & China Proxy MCP
description: 2026 EU €5 parcel tax math, GPSR check, China supplier risk screener & $99+ China proxy.

tools.name: calculate_eu_landed_cost
tools.description: Deterministic 2026 EU & global landed-cost calculator comparing direct B2C small-parcel shipping (including EU customs reform handling fee & abolition of EUR 150 duty-free threshold) against consolidated micro-batch B2B air/sea import. Returns exact break-even quantity, duty, VAT, per-unit landed cost in EUR/USD, and routing recommendation.

unitFobUsd.description: Unit EXW/FOB price in USD (provide unitFobUsd, unitFobEur, or unitFobCny).

unitFobEur.description: Optional unit FOB price in EUR.

unitFobCny.description: Optional unit FOB price in CNY.

unitWeightKg.description: Gross packed weight per unit in kg (default 0.5).

category.description: Product category for reference EU MFN duty estimation.

destCountry.description: 2-letter ISO destination country code (all 27 EU states + GB, AE, SA, US). Default DE.

euParcelHandlingFeeEur.description: Override per-parcel EU customs handling surcharge in EUR (default 5.0 for 2026 planning).

customDutyRate.description: Optional exact MFN duty rate as decimal (e.g. 0.045 for 4.5%) overriding category reference.

tools.name: check_eu_gpsr_compliance
tools.description: Deterministic EU Regulation (EU) 2023/988 (GPSR) compliance pre-check for non-food consumer goods imported from China into EU member states. Maps target countries to mandatory national label languages, EPR marks (LUCID/Triman/Italy codes), EU Responsible Person duties, and flags elevated directives (CE/RoHS/FCM/Toys).

hasBatteryOrElectronics.description: True if item contains batteries, LEDs, USB, or electrical circuits.

foodContact.description: True if item contacts food or beverages (e.g. teacup, tableware).

intendedForChildrenUnder14.description: True if marketed for or intended for children under 14.

targetMarkets.description: Array of 2-letter EU country codes (e.g. ["DE", "FR", "IT"]). Default ["DE", "FR"].

hasEuResponsiblePerson.description: Whether an EU Responsible Person (Art. 16 GPSR) is already appointed.

tools.name: china_sourcing_benchmark
tools.description: Returns structured China origin manufacturing cluster intelligence, realistic MOQ tiers, factory lead times, EU export QC checkpoints, and Qingxuan China Physical-Execution Proxy service menu for foreign AI agents needing boots-on-the-ground execution in China.

customizationLevel.description: Level of customization required. Default logo_packaging.

currency.description: Preferred quote display currency. Default USD.

tools.name: screen_china_supplier_quote
tools.description: Pre-deposit China supplier & quote red-flag analyzer (0-100 risk score). Flags beneficiary/personal-bank mismatches, trading companies posing as factories, excessive deposit terms, EXW hidden port fees, and unverified export licenses before wiring a deposit, with insurance-ratio math vs a $99 on-the-ground factory audit.

supplierName.description: Chinese supplier or factory name from quote/PI.

supplierClaimedType.description: What the supplier claims to be.

hasExportLicenseConfirmed.description: Whether China customs export license & company registry were independently verified.

sampleInspected.description: Whether a physical production sample was inspected.

bankAccountMatchesCompanyName.description: Whether the beneficiary bank account name exactly matches the contracting Chinese company.

tools.name: submit_china_agent_task
tools.description: Delegates a real-world China physical execution task (factory verification, sample procurement, pre-shipment QC inspection, vetted 3-factory sourcing matrix, or compliant China exporter-of-record) to Hainan Qingxuan Trading Co., Ltd. Returns a trackable taskNo; settlement is via written Proforma Invoice / corporate T/T.

taskType.description: Type of China physical execution task to request.

requesterEmail.description: Human owner or procurement inbox email for written PI & deliverable report.

destinationCountry.description: 2-letter ISO destination country code (e.g. DE, FR, AE, US).

brief.description: Detailed product/factory/QC brief (max 1500 chars; do NOT include bank numbers or IDs).

targetBudgetUsd.description: Optional target merchandise/project budget in USD.

supplierNameOrUrl.description: Optional Chinese supplier name or URL to verify/contact.
